items.exampleEn: Workers must wear a mask when they paint the walls.
items.exampleZh: 工人粉刷牆壁時必須戴口罩。

items.exampleEn: The manager overlooked the fact that the shop was closed on Mondays.
items.exampleZh: 經理沒注意到那家店星期一公休。

items.exampleEn: The teacher used pictures to reinforce the new words.
items.exampleZh: 老師用圖片來加強新單字的學習。

items.exampleEn: We need to check the effectiveness of the new training.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要檢驗新訓練的成效。

items.exampleEn: The workers assemble the cars by hand in this factory.
items.exampleZh: 這家工廠的工人用手工組裝汽車。

items.exampleEn: The new software will facilitate communication between teams.
items.exampleZh: 新軟體會讓團隊之間的溝通更順暢。

items.exampleEn: Finding a replacement for sugar in this cake recipe was not easy.
items.exampleZh: 要為這個蛋糕食譜找到糖的替代品並不容易。

items.exampleEn: Please write your name on this pad of paper.
items.exampleZh: 請把你的名字寫在這本便條紙上。

items.sentenceEn: Please assemble in the main hall at nine for the safety talk.
items.sentenceZh: 請九點到大廳集合，參加安全講習。

items.audioEn: If your mask is damaged, please ask the front desk for a replacement.
items.audioZh: 如果你的口罩破了，請向櫃台換一個新的。
options: Go home early and rest for the day
Buy a new one at the shop next door
Fix it yourself with a piece of tape
Ask the front desk for a new one

items.sentenceEn: Don't overlook the small print at the bottom of the contract.
items.sentenceZh: 別忽略合約最下面的小字。

items.sentenceEn: Regular practice will reinforce what you learned in class.
items.sentenceZh: 經常練習能加強你在課堂上學到的東西。

items.stemEn: Clear signs can ____ the flow of visitors through the museum.
items.stemZh: 清楚的標示能讓參觀者在博物館裡走動得更順暢。

items.stemEn: The old printer broke, so we ordered a ____.
items.stemZh: 舊印表機壞了，所以我們訂了一台替換的。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, our office got new desks. On Saturday morning, we all assembled in the lobby, and the manager handed out tools. The desks came in boxes, and putting them together was harder than we expected. One desk was missing a leg, so the supplier sent a replacement on Monday. We also put soft pads under the chair legs to protect the new floor, and we reinforced the heavy shelves with metal bars. Everyone wore a mask because of the dust. The new seating plan is meant to facilitate teamwork, and so far, its effectiveness is clear: people talk more. My only mistake? I overlooked one small part, and my desk still moves a little.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們辦公室換了新桌子。星期六早上，大家在大廳集合，經理發工具給我們。桌子是裝在箱子裡送來的，組裝起來比我們預期的難。有一張桌子少了一隻桌腳，所以供應商星期一寄來替換的。我們也在椅腳下墊了軟墊來保護新地板，並用金屬條加固了沉重的架子。因為灰塵很多，大家都戴著口罩。新的座位安排是為了促進團隊合作，到目前為止效果很明顯：大家交談變多了。我唯一的失誤？我漏掉了一個小零件，所以我的桌子到現在還會晃。

questions.questionZh: 新的座位安排是為了什麼？

items.promptZh: 你能幫我組裝這張椅子嗎？
referenceEn: Can you help me assemble this chair?
Could you help me to assemble this chair?
rubricZh: assemble 後面直接接要組裝的東西（例如 assemble this chair）
請求可用 Can you…?、Could you…? 等；help me 後面接原形動詞，加 to 也可以

items.promptZh: 這家餐廳很容易被忽略，因為它在一條小巷子裡。
referenceEn: This restaurant is easy to overlook because it is on a small side street.
It's easy to overlook this restaurant because it is down a narrow lane.
rubricZh: overlook 表示「忽略、沒注意到」（例如 easy to overlook、is often overlooked 等）
「小巷子」可寫，例如 a small side street、a narrow lane、an alley 等
